g.text: T4 / T6 / T8 / T16 = number of inference loops; d = query hop count. Hollow diamonds: shared initializer. Stars: final-budget DEV.
Dashed vertical line: equal declared budget 3.0670848B; points use actual logged work. The proxy is not FLOPs; prior shared warmup is excluded.
Missing observations are not zero. Lines join observed DEV only. Intermediate/final DEV is not independent confirmation; no test data.
Dotted horizontal guides: 12.5% random answer choice (unseen panel), 70% task-learning floor (training-task panel).
